mapper.select: SELECT fr.*, f.name AS flow_name FROM file_resource fr LEFT JOIN flow f ON f.id = fr.flow_id WHERE fr.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM file_resource WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} AND file_type = 'EXAMPLE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_resource (flow_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, content_type, file_type, description, user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{fileType}, #{description}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE file_resource SET file_name = #{fileName}, file_path = #{filePath}, file_size = #{fileSize}, content_type = #{contentType}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
